independent_computation.step_2_what_a_support_event_is: The cached worklists and audit corpus define the support ledger as the ALLY-FACING heal/shield ledger, emitted by support_effects.derive_ally_effects / item_support_effects: (a) data/worklists/e8d-task.md — 'ALLY-SUPPORT heals/shields (champion emits a support event targeting allies; the ledger already tracks support_shield_received / support heals from items — reuse the same event shape)'; (b) data/champion-audit/batch-3.json (Lulu) — 'E shield is emitted by support_effects.derive_ally_effects when E is cast (verified in deep-audit-2026-08 2.3: "Help, Pix! · Shield Strength" 230 -> main)', i.e. a granter/recipient ledger whose entries name the participant that produced the effect and the participant that received it; (c) data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json — the three support entries are all kind 'support_shield' with a named source (Molten Shield, Fimbulwinter) and applied/received/absorbed amounts.
independent_computation.step_3_ownership_of_the_scenario_effects: Both coupling effects the scenario's items produce are TARGET-SIDE debuffs, not owner-scoped grants: Carve 'inflicts armor reduction' on the enemy (docs/math-foundations.md 2.2-2.3 treats armor reduction as target state — reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct), reduction may go negative, penetration floors at 0, and 2.3 item 2 prices Black Cleaver as an average-stack shred of the target's armor), and Expose Weakness explicitly increases the target's damage taken 'from all sources'. Neither benefit belongs to a single owner in the ledger sense; both benefit every damage source on the team.
independent_computation.step_4_can_the_main_own_a_support_event_: No sourced path exists. Neither Black Cleaver nor Bloodsong grants a heal or a shield to anyone, so neither can emit an entry into the ally heal/shield ledger at all — with or without an owner. And Bloodsong's own acquisitionNote gates it behind the support quest (World Atlas -> Runic Compass -> Bounty of Worlds -> free upgrade), i.e. the team member who actually carries it in an ordinary Summoner's Rift roster is the support ally, not the Black-Cleaver main. An entry in this scenario's support ledger stamped owner='main' therefore has no basis in the cached effect text: it is either an entry that should not exist, or an entry whose sourced holder is the ally support — under neither reading is 'main' the correct owner.
independent_computation.conclusion: 'main' is not supportable from the cached wiki text for this scenario; the leaf's disappearance is consistent with it. The new state (leaf absent) is the correct one.
